patch_description: This candidate merges the two strongest prior designs. From the high-scoring "ry_a/ry_b split" ansatz we keep the alternating‑wire RY encoding layers (odd/even split), the forward‑then‑backward CNOT entangling chain, and the disjoint‑pair CRZ entangler with a single shared parameter, all of which produced the best validation margin and worst‑group margin (0.42 score). From the parameter‑economical current program we adopt the idea of collapsing the two separate RZ layers (rz_a/rz_b) into a single shared "rz" parameter, cutting one more distinct parameter while preserving the same circuit topology and depth of information mixing. The result keeps the effective entangling/rotation structure that generalizes well (alternating single-qubit encoding, bidirectional nearest-neighbor entanglement, then disjoint-pair parametrized entanglement, then a global closing rotation) but with only 5 distinct trainable parameters (down from 6), which the scoring function rewards directly through parameter efficiency while retaining the good margin properties of the higher-scoring parent circuit.
